description: Price and stock for a list of items, the subtotal, and whether the order can be bought online now (published prices, within the payment limits) or needs a quote.

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

name: check_price_and_stock

can_checkout.description: True when start_checkout can sell these items now; otherwise use request_quote

availability.description: Stock status: in_stock, backorder (available to order) or out_of_stock

line_total_usd.description: Quantity times unit price in USD, null when priced on request

unit_price_usd.description: Price per selling unit in USD, null when priced on request

reason.description: Why the items can't be bought online, null when they can

subtotal_usd.description: Goods subtotal in USD before shipping and tax, null when any item is priced on request

title: Check price and stock
